source.model: docs/assets/jet-suit/jet-suit.json (59 lines, 76 parts, 7 steps): the sixth version of the lesson
source.authoring: Hand-built. A Claude agent wrote this JSON by hand from fact-checked research and a merged fact key. It is not the output of the engine's AI loop answering a prompt. Its content is the reviewed sixth version (a one-line file, SHA-256 6d8360e01e625b44eab4d17afe21318bf1aababa83483a7e6ae83f184feeaa59) with two label anchors changed and both ends of arrow aTL2 moved (see changeFromReviewed: what and arrowMove). The file is laid out one part, label, arrow and step per line, as the fifth version was; parsed, it equals the reviewed JSON except for those two label anchors and the x and y offsets of the two aTL2 ends (0, 0 -> -25.702, -132.153).
source.license: Apache-2.0; procedural geometry, no images, models or stock assets

changeFromReviewed.what: The same two anchor changes that PR #40 made to the fifth version, so that the strict anchor rules accept the file: lComb anchor {"part": "back.combustor", "offset": [30, 0, 148]} -> {"part": "back.combustor", "offset": [0, -30, 148]} (inside the annular chamber, on the cut face); lPilot anchor {"part": "helmet", "offset": [0, -110, 0]} -> {"part": "helmet", "offset": [0, 108, 0]} (the back of the helmet, which faces the step 1 camera). No text, fact, part, step, pose or camera changed. No further anchor move was needed.
changeFromReviewed.changesFromTheFifthVersion: Step 5 poses the pilot (both upper arms swing back, elbows straight); five exhaust plume parts (named "Exhaust plume (illustration)") are shown in steps 2 and 5 only; highlights name whole engine instances; explode vectors are set per instance; the two cutaway disclaimer labels are one two-line label; the step 3 back-share label adds "(Browning, 2021)"; the step 5 flow arrow starts at an arm engine's exhaust; step 7 adds a turn arrow (aSpin) on back.shaft.
changeFromReviewed.arrowMove: The strict arrow-visibility rule (this pull request) found that arrow aTL2 (the inner left-arm engine) had its head behind the pack in step 2 (73 % of its samples visible, 0 of 3 head samples). Its two anchors take the check's own suggested move, 134.629 mm toward the step 2 camera with the same direction and length: from {"part": "armL2.intake", "offset": [0, 0, -15]} -> {"part": "armL2.intake", "offset": [-25.702, -132.153, -15]}, to {"part": "armL2.intake", "offset": [0, 0, -260]} -> {"part": "armL2.intake", "offset": [-25.702, -132.153, -260]} (armL2.intake names the part armL2.intakeLip; the suggestion names that part). No text, fact, part, step, pose or camera changed.

review.facts: Every factual sentence maps to a row of the merged fact key (F1-F20) in docs/assets/jet-suit/SOURCES.md. The key merges two independent AI model web fact-checks (GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash). The sixth version adds no fact.
review.verdict: An independent read-only review of the reviewed sixth-version JSON gave PUBLIC-OK for the 7 step stills and hero.png. It checked the story video at its 7 hold frames and one frame of the move into step 5; an addendum checked two frames of the move out of step 5, and with it the story video is PUBLIC-OK. The exploded view was not added to the public set.
review.differenceFromReviewedRenders: The reviewed renders used the earlier two anchors and a one-line file, so their subtitle read "(1 line)". CoreGraphics RGB comparison of each new still with the reviewed still, top-left image coordinates: in every still, channels differ by more than 24/255 only in the subtitle (x 345-655, y 82-94: "(59 lines)") and, in step 1, the box x 459-842, y 132-187 (the moved "Schematic pilot" label and dot) and, in step 6, the box x 327-626, y 369-435 (the moved "Combustion chamber" label and dot). Outside those boxes no channel differs by more than 24/255 (render noise); in total 0.21 % to 1.41 % of channels differ per still, the boxes included.
review.builderInspection: The builder viewed all 7 new stills, hero.png and the extracted story frames listed under artifacts.story.mp4.inspected. Step 1: the "Schematic pilot" dot is solid, on the back of the helmet. Step 6: the "Combustion chamber" dot is inside the copper chamber. Steps 2 and 5 show the plumes; no other step does.
review.arrowMoveCheck: The builder compared each new still with the shipped one (CoreGraphics RGB, threshold 24/255): hero.png and steps 1 and 3-7 have no differing pixel; step 2 differs only in the box x 538-576, y 265-337 (740 pixels: the moved aTL2 arrow). The independent review verdict above was given for the earlier aTL2 position; this move was not reviewed again.

story.mp4.from: render story.mp4, re-encoded for size with fast start (see reencode)

renderedOriginal.note: The engine's story.mp4 (1890 frames, 30 fps, 63 s, 7 beats of 9 s; every move path straight, no cuts; video only). Not kept in git: 13.1 MB.

story.mp4.reencode: AVFoundation only: AVAssetReader (32BGRA) to AVAssetWriter, H.264 High profile (auto level), average 1,000,000 bit/s, key frame at most every 60 frames, every source frame kept (1890 in, 1890 decoded out), fast start (the writer puts moov before mdat; atoms ftyp, moov, mdat). The same encoder settings as the earlier refreshes. A small Swift script outside the repository (source SHA-256 5d07779e2e2cd162eacf806bb64d2cb959444574e182ccf9d04f48fff96c3dff); no other tool.
story.mp4.inspected: Frames were extracted from this file with AVAssetImageGenerator (zero time tolerance): the 7 hold frames at 5, 14, 23, 32, 41, 50 and 59 s were compared with the step stills (CoreGraphics RGB: at most 0.12 % of pixels differ by more than 24/255, scattered encoder noise) and viewed; the step 2 hold shows aTL2 with its head in front of the arm. The move into step 2 at 9.33 s (arrows drawn, no labels or caption) and the move out of step 5 at 45.33 s (only the engine is shown, no labels or caption; the legend stays) were viewed.
